Hankinnan kohteena oleva ulkovalaistusverkko käsittää Nurmijärven kunnan hallinnoiman ulkovalaistusverkon, jonka laajuus on noin 14 000 valopistettä. {"recordId":"eed7ae69d6605df2427c9c5d","country":"FI","sourceId":"FI-portal","sourceName":"HILMA complete public notices","sourceUrl":"https://www.hankintailmoitukset.fi/en/public/procurement/55076/notice/83764/overview","noticeId":"OLD-83764","procedureId":"OLD:55076","title":"94-GHz dual-polarisation Doppler cloud radar","description":"The purchase is for a 94-GHz dual-polarisation Doppler cloud radar with a blower system. ACTRIS is a pan-European distributed research infrastructure making long-term measurements of aerosol, clouds and trace gases at atmospheric observatories. The cloud radar will form part of FMIs contribution to this observation network, specifically the cloud profiling network, and will be deployed permanently in Kenttärova (Pallas). To belong to this observation network, the instrument must meet the specifications of the European-wide ACTRIS network. The cloud radar must also fulfil the scientific goals of FMI, which is to obtain the vertical profile of liquid water content and ice water content in clouds. Cloud radars operate at very specific frequencies due to the atmospheric windows (centred on 35, 94, 140, 215 GHz) and frequency allocation (government regulation). The only method for obtaining the vertical profile of liquid water content is to use the dual-frequency approach, i.e. transmit at two different frequencies and use the difference in the vertical profile of attenuation experienced by the two frequencies. This means that the two frequencies must be in different atmospheric windows (e.g. one at 35 GHz and one at 94 GHz). The cloud radar will be paired with the 35 GHz cloud radar that FMI already owns and operated. Since there are no cloud radars available commercially at frequencies above 100 GHz, the cloud radar must operate at 94 GHz. A passive channel for measuring LWP is required in order to be able to account for the attenuation of the radar beam by liquid clouds when making quantitative measurements in ice clouds above them, and for constraining the dual-frequency measurements.
